facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary and secondary endpoints overall; subgroup positive · Phase 2b · envudeucitinib in SLE · not yet approved

evidence.summary: LUMUS trial did not meet its primary and secondary endpoints in the overall trial population
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: its Phase 2b LUMUS trial of envudeucitinib for the treatment of moderate-to-severe systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) did not meet its primary and secondary endpoints in the overall trial population
evidence.safety: In LUMUS, envudeucitinib was well tolerated and demonstrated a favorable safety profile with no new safety signals.
evidence.program_discontinued: We plan to engage regulators to discuss Phase 3 development for envudeucitinib.
